## Audit, sources and actual domain

All 768 parameter triples were examined and both formulas were considered. 1536 complete formula rows were actually evaluated. The temporary audit has 1261253 bytes and SHA256 323d80d17896e972a3e6ff4ef52981f0b0f7acb48299437474ad6a21e38dd475. It is not persisted. The JSON preserves every selected row, all source bounds, both conditional readouts and all coefficient/gate identities.
The collar is [17/20,19/20], cut 9/10, ordinary measure dr and normalized original moving angle. All low means, shell and low legs, cutoff sources and radial P units remain. The global LC Pnorm upper bounds the same-cut radial factor and is paid exactly once. F96 and its angular bound come from the same completed WC source; F288=F288,phi=0 only for the same true residual-zero state.
The wide C0 radius remains a hypothesis on the same real two-sided H1 solution. A conditional high-body bound from that hypothesis is displayed separately; it is not an actual unknown estimate. The direct H1 route neither uses nor extends the narrow MA domain.
No actual low/shell/cut norm, low-curvature entry, core solution or full matching is supplied. For a nonzero-residual iterate its complete ordinary source and angular source remain required.
All 16 structural verdicts and any t1 failures are preserved in the complete small JSON.
